title: Bridge to B1: Spontaneous Fluency & Extended Responses
group: A2.3 - World Explorations, Stories & Bridge to B1
objective: Mampu memberikan jawaban panjang, merangkai argumen dengan alasan, dan merespons pertanyaan tak terduga secara lancar

theory.summary: Di level ini, kamu akan belajar memberikan jawaban yang lebih panjang dan terstruktur, bukan hanya jawaban singkat. Kamu akan menggunakan pola P.R.E (Point - Reason - Example): mulai dengan poin utama, berikan alasan, lalu tambahkan contoh. Discourse markers seperti 'Actually', 'Honestly', 'Well', dan 'To be fair' akan membuatmu terdengar lebih natural dan lancar seperti penutur asli. Ini adalah jembatan menuju level B1 di mana kamu bisa berdiskusi dengan percaya diri!
rules: Extended Response Structure: Point + Reason + Example. Contoh: 'I prefer online shopping. (Point) It saves time because I don't need to go to the mall. (Reason) For instance, last week I bought shoes online in just 10 minutes.' (Example)

Discourse Markers untuk transisi natural: 'Well' (untuk memulai/berpikir), 'Actually' (mengoreksi/menambah info), 'Honestly' (menyatakan opini jujur), 'To be fair' (memberi perspektif seimbang). Contoh: 'Well, I think traveling is important. Actually, it changed my perspective last year.'

Handling Unexpected Questions: Gunakan fillers untuk memberi waktu berpikir: 'That's an interesting question...', 'Let me think...', 'I've never thought about that, but...'. Contoh: 'That's an interesting question. I suppose I would choose the beach because I enjoy swimming and relaxing by the water.'

commonTrap.trapTitle: Peringatan: Jawaban Terlalu Pendek Tanpa Struktur
commonTrap.explanation: Banyak siswa A2 hanya menjawab dengan satu kalimat pendek tanpa memberikan alasan atau contoh. Ini membuat percakapan terasa tidak lengkap dan kurang natural.
commonTrap.wrong: Do you like reading? - Yes, I do.
commonTrap.correct: Do you like reading? - Yes, I really enjoy it. Actually, reading helps me relax after work. For example, I just finished a mystery novel last week and it was fascinating.

dialogue.context: Sarah dan David sedang ngobrol santai di kedai kopi tentang hobi mereka. Sarah menanyakan pendapat David tentang fotografi, dan David memberikan jawaban panjang dengan struktur yang jelas.

lines.speaker: Sarah
lines.text: David, I know you're into photography. What do you love most about it?
lines.translation: David, aku tahu kamu suka fotografi. Apa yang paling kamu sukai dari hobi itu?

lines.speaker: David
lines.text: Well, I think photography helps me see the world differently. Actually, it makes me more observant of small details. For instance, last weekend I noticed how beautiful morning light looks on old buildings.
lines.translation: Yah, menurutku fotografi membantuku melihat dunia dengan cara berbeda. Sebenarnya, itu membuatku lebih memperhatikan detail kecil. Misalnya, akhir pekan lalu aku memperhatikan betapa indahnya cahaya pagi di gedung-gedung tua.

lines.speaker: Sarah
lines.text: That sounds fascinating! Do you prefer shooting landscapes or people?
lines.translation: Kedengarannya menarik! Kamu lebih suka memotret pemandangan atau orang?

lines.speaker: David
lines.text: Honestly, I prefer landscapes. To be fair, photographing people requires more confidence to approach them. I feel more comfortable capturing natural scenery where I can take my time.
lines.translation: Sejujurnya, aku lebih suka pemandangan. Sejujurnya, memotret orang membutuhkan lebih banyak kepercayaan diri untuk mendekati mereka. Aku merasa lebih nyaman mengabadikan pemandangan alam di mana aku bisa mengambil waktu.

lines.speaker: Sarah
lines.text: That makes sense. Have you ever thought about doing it professionally?
lines.translation: Itu masuk akal. Apakah kamu pernah berpikir untuk melakukannya secara profesional?

lines.speaker: David
lines.text: That's an interesting question. I suppose it could be rewarding, but initially I want to keep it as a hobby. The pressure of deadlines might take away the joy I currently feel when shooting for fun.
lines.translation: Itu pertanyaan yang menarik. Aku rasa itu bisa memuaskan, tapi pada awalnya aku ingin tetap menjadikannya hobi. Tekanan deadline mungkin menghilangkan kesenangan yang saat ini kurasakan saat memotret untuk bersenang-senang.

speakingLab.context: Kamu sedang berdiskusi dengan Mr. Khoirul tentang kebiasaan belajar bahasa Inggris. Mr. Khoirul akan mengajukan pertanyaan yang membutuhkan jawaban panjang dan terstruktur. Gunakan pola P.R.E dan discourse markers untuk menjawab dengan lancar!

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Hello! I'd love to hear about your English learning journey. What methods have you found most effective for improving your speaking skills?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: Well, I think practicing with native speakers is the most effective method. Actually, it helps me learn natural expressions that I can't find in textbooks. For example, I joined an online language exchange last month and my confidence improved significantly.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: That's wonderful progress! Now, let me ask you something unexpected: If you could only use English for one activity for the rest of your life, what would it be and why?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: That's an interesting question. Let me think... I suppose I would choose watching movies in English. Honestly, it combines entertainment with learning. To be fair, movies expose me to different accents, cultural contexts, and everyday vocabulary that's very practical.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Excellent reasoning! One more question: Some people say making mistakes is the best way to learn. Do you agree with this perspective?

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: Yes, I completely agree with that. Making mistakes helps me identify my weak points. Actually, I used to be afraid of speaking, but after making errors and learning from them, I became more confident. For instance, I once confused 'borrow' and 'lend', but now I never make that mistake again.

turns.speaker: Mr. Khoirul
turns.text: Perfect! Your extended responses show great fluency. You're definitely ready for B1 level conversations. Keep practicing with this structure!

turns.speaker: You
turns.text: Thank you so much, Mr. Khoirul! This practice really helped me organize my thoughts better. I feel more prepared to handle spontaneous questions now.

quiz.question: Choose the correct extended response: "Do you enjoy working in teams?" - "___"
options: Yes, I do.
Yes, I enjoy it. Actually, teamwork helps me learn from others. For example, my last project taught me new problem-solving skills.
I like teams very much and they are good.
quiz.answer: Yes, I enjoy it. Actually, teamwork helps me learn from others. For example, my last project taught me new problem-solving skills.
quiz.explanation: Jawaban ini menggunakan struktur P.R.E yang lengkap: Point (I enjoy it), Reason (teamwork helps me learn), dan Example (my last project). Jawaban pertama terlalu pendek, dan jawaban ketiga tidak terstruktur dengan baik.

quiz.question: Which discourse marker is best to introduce an honest opinion? "___ speaking, I don't think that movie was very good."
options: Actually
Frankly
Initially
quiz.explanation: 'Frankly' atau 'Honestly' digunakan untuk menyatakan opini jujur dan terus terang. 'Actually' digunakan untuk mengoreksi atau menambah informasi, sedangkan 'Initially' berarti 'pada awalnya' untuk urutan waktu.

quiz.question: Complete the sentence with the correct filler for unexpected questions: "___ I've never considered that before, but I suppose traveling alone could be quite liberating."
options: Well,
For example,
To be fair,
quiz.explanation: 'Well' adalah filler yang tepat untuk memulai jawaban sambil memberi waktu berpikir, terutama untuk pertanyaan tak terduga. 'For example' digunakan untuk memberi contoh, dan 'To be fair' untuk memberi perspektif seimbang.

quiz.question: Identify the best extended answer structure: "Why do you prefer online learning?" - "___"
options: I prefer online learning because it's flexible. To be fair, it allows me to study at my own pace. For instance, I completed three courses last month while working full-time.
Online learning is good and flexible.
Because I like it and it's convenient for my schedule.
quiz.answer: I prefer online learning because it's flexible. To be fair, it allows me to study at my own pace. For instance, I completed three courses last month while working full-time.
quiz.explanation: Jawaban ini sempurna karena memiliki struktur lengkap: Point (prefer online learning, it's flexible), Reason (study at own pace) dengan discourse marker 'To be fair', dan Example (completed three courses) dengan penanda 'For instance'.

quiz.question: Which response correctly uses 'Actually' as a discourse marker? "Do you exercise regularly?" - "___"
options: Yes, I exercise. Actually, I started jogging every morning this year and it improved my energy levels.
Actually yes I do exercise sometimes.
I actually do exercise and it's good.
quiz.answer: Yes, I exercise. Actually, I started jogging every morning this year and it improved my energy levels.
quiz.explanation: 'Actually' di sini digunakan dengan benar untuk menambahkan informasi spesifik setelah poin utama. Kalimat ini juga menunjukkan struktur yang baik dengan reason dan example yang natural. Pilihan lain tidak menggunakan 'Actually' dengan fungsi discourse marker yang tepat.
